$comment: Scoped permissions so ingestion can run unattended -- both a headless
`claude -p --agent ingest` and the scheduled scripts/run_daily_check.sh,
which otherwise stalls on its first Bash call with nobody there to approve.
The allow-list is deliberately per-script rather than a blanket
Bash(python3 scripts/*), so adding a new script is a conscious decision
rather than something that inherits unattended execution for free.
The deny rules encode CLAUDE.md's hard invariants. deny wins over allow, so
these hold even if an allow rule is later loosened:
- git WRITES (commit/push/add/reset/rebase/merge/checkout/restore) are
forbidden; only the orchestrator (interactive human) and the weekly
launchd backup job commit. Read-only git (status/log/diff/show) is
allowed for diagnostics -- it cannot mutate the repo or push.
- raw/ transcript CONTENTS are immutable (mv between the two raw trees is
the one permitted change, and is allowed below)
- no deletion: transcripts are expensive to re-transcribe
- no network: every fact must come from the transcript on disk
TWO MATCHING RULES LEARNED THE HARD WAY, both verified by experiment:
1. File rules must use Edit(path). A Write(path) rule is inert -- Edit(path)
is what covers every file-editing tool, Write included.
2. Bash prefixes match at TOKEN granularity, not character granularity.
Bash(python3 scripts/state_io.py:*) works because the prefix ends on a
token boundary. Bash(mv raw/transcripts/:*) silently matches NOTHING,
because the real argument is raw/transcripts/<show>/<file>.md and the
prefix stops mid-token -- the rule looks scoped and simply never fires.
3. Edit(raw/**) also refuses a shell `mv` of anything under raw/, not just
the Edit/Write tools. Broadening Bash(mv:*) did NOT unblock the ingest
finalize step, because the deny is path-based and wins. That is the
correct outcome -- it is what makes transcript immutability real rather
than advisory -- so the ingest flow no longer moves files itself.
verify_integrity.py --fix performs the relocation and syncs staged_path;
see CLAUDE.md ingest step 9. mv stays allowed for everything outside raw/.
